title: Bound steady-state causal completion polling using existing destination settlement receipts
outcome: Before production supervisor integration, settled original causal requests stop causing repeated federation reads through a receipt-aware termination or pruning condition owned by existing settlement machinery, without a second completion ledger.
acceptance: Behavioral evidence shows an already settled original is skipped before another remote RPC while unresolved originals and disconnect recovery remain eligible.
Retained original operation/receipt replay, immutable facts, bounded paging and fairness remain preserved; no fabricated credit or parallel delivered registry is introduced.
